claims.summary: In characteristic three, for d>=4, A=16d-16, B=16d-32, N=A+B, q=3^e>=N and alpha=(q+1)/2, the coefficient [a6^(B alpha)] D_(6,d) is nonzero iff q<=N+15. In those cases the original integral determinant has exact last-parameter degree B alpha and the series is generically normal. Supported families are d=(3^e+37)/32 for e=3 mod8,e>=11; d=(3^e+47)/32 for e=4 mod8,e>=4; d=(3^e+45)/32 for e=5 mod8,e>=5; and d=(3^e+39)/32 for e=6 mod8,e>=6. Vanishing outside this window concerns only this coefficient.
claims.assessment: Working proof: shifted-block support gives the exact four families; compatible safe confluences give conic matching matrices of size at most twelve. Their low-parameter entries are uniform in each exponent class by Frobenius/Lucas modulo81. Exact polynomial leading terms and explicit cofactor-based truncation bounds prove nonvanishing; the smallest e=4 case has exact original and conic certificates. Independent direct-jet comparisons check both matching shapes. Most other degrees, primes and dimensions remain open.
claims.rationale: Proves four unbounded characteristic-three normality families outside the ten prior Catalan-unit degree classes, through an actual coupled coefficient rather than separate-block normality. This is a dimension-six extension of the earlier moving-coefficient method; no independent novelty claim is made for the base identity.
claims.next_action: Find an adaptive actual coefficient outside the unit classes and this support window, or control the remaining twenty-row paired determinant without dropping its source conditions.

conj:cube-refined-initial-segment-law.mathematical_status: Four additional characteristic-three dimension-six Frobenius families are now proved.

conj:cube-refined-initial-segment-law.assessment: Conjecture in the remaining n>=6 small-prime range outside established subranges. Proved in characteristic zero for all n,d; in every characteristic not two for n<=5 and d>=2; for p>2^(n-1)d; and in the recorded periodic bands d=b+tp with b>=n-2 and p>2^(n-1)b, including the stated residue intervals. Degree-one orders retain the separate Catalan law. Generic normality does not determine pre-stable threshold degrees. At n=6,d>=4 the exact Catalan-unit classes are proved, including ten degree classes modulo81 at p=3 and all p>32d-34; failure of this sufficient unit test does not imply nonnormality. The four supported q=3^e moving-coefficient families in thm:cube-six-frobenius-sharp-degree are also proved.
